clips.title: The story
paras: At Deathknell’s edge, Deathguard Simmer sizes up newly risen Forsaken. He sends them west to raid a human pumpkin farm patrolled by the Scarlet Crusade, gathering reagents Brill’s apothecaries need.

Deathguard Simmer guards the ground just outside Deathknell, where the Forsaken hold the line between their haven and Tirisfal Glades. Living humans roam the region, including the fanatical Scarlet Crusade, who see all undead as abominations to purge with fire and blade. Simmer tests newly risen Forsaken by sending them west to Solliden Farmstead. Scarlet Crusade soldiers patrol from a nearby tower. The recruits must steal ten pumpkins and carry them to Apothecary Johaan in Brill.
